biggest_catch: You cannot re-shop the same apartment community — once recognized, you're done there, so the territory is finite.
catches: Each community can only be shopped once per shopper — finite local territory.
A phone shop must come before the onsite visit; a wasted trip without an appointment is not paid.
Tour + detailed report runs long (up to ~3 hours all-in).
Shop volume depends on apartment communities in your area.
